newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee inches up as dollar demand evaporates.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee inches up as dollar demand evaporates.

text.p: The Indian rupee inched up against the dollar on Thursday afternoon as dollar demand dried up, dealers said.
The rupee gained to 35.775/780 from 35.78/79 opening as the leading bank State Bank of India and the Reserve Bank of India were not active, dealers said.
The rupee saw a high of 35.7775 and a low of 35.7925 on Thursday, they said.
Dollar inflows continued unabated from various sources even as demand petered out. The forward dollar market was relatively inactive, dealers said.
